name: CME Globex equity index calendar for NQ, MNQ, ES and MES
session_rule: A session is dated the New York day it ends: from 18:00 New York the evening before up to normal_close, or up to close_ny on a row with a time. Saturday and Sunday are never session dates. A weekday in the covered range with no row is a normal session.

kinds.closed: no session is dated this day
kinds.halt: a CME holiday: Globex equity index trades from 18:00 the evening before until close_ny, and CME books those trades to the next trade date
kinds.early: a session with its own trade date that ends early, at close_ny

checks.kind_check: cme: a CME Group page states this session's kind for equity index futures. unverified: CME lists the holiday on this date, but no CME text that could be read states the equity index kind.
checks.time_check: cme: a CME Group page states close_ny for equity index futures. unverified: the time follows the standing CME equity pattern (13:00 New York on a holiday halt, 13:15 New York on an early close) or a non-CME lead only. null on a closed row.

how_checked: 2026-11-18, CME Group pages read through a web search index only: cmegroup.com refuses automated reading (HTTP 403 under its Data Terms of Use), and nothing was done to get around that. Anthony's rule of 2026-11-18: a CME Group page (holiday calendar, clearing advisory, settlement notice, press release or notice) seen through a search index counts as confirmed, so a check is cme when such a page states the kind or the time, and unverified when no CME page gives it. Pages from anyone else are leads and never proof: CME is the only source that counts. The 2024 and 2025 rows were added on 2026-11-18 (plan step 1.5), and every row was checked again by this rule that day.
